subject: dml: fix the data/index inconsistency when updating partial index or using on dup key update (#65808)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. Changes consistently apply partial-index conditions across (1) ON DUPLICATE KEY/unique-key precheck, (2) UPDATE index rebuild decisions when only condition columns change (via AffectColumn), and (3) ADMIN RECOVER INDEX by skipping rows not meeting the condition while still tracking scan progress. No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched executor/table behavior, and later history up to upstream/master shows no follow-up fix specifically for these changes.
